title: How to Manage Course Status and Bulk Actions

sections.heading: How to Change a Course's Status

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Click **Courses** in the left sidebar to view your course list.
steps.context: left sidebar to view your course list

steps.raw_text: Hover over the course you want to modify.
Click the **status indicator** or select **Edit** to open the course settings.
steps.context: or select Edit to open the course settings

steps.raw_text: Locate the **Status** dropdown and choose the desired status: **Published**, **Draft**, **Hidden**, **Archived**, or **Scheduled**.
steps.context: dropdown and choose the desired status: Published, Draft, Hidden, Archived, or S

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to apply the change.

sections.heading: Scheduling a Course for Future Publication

steps.raw_text: Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** and open the course you want to schedule.
steps.context: > Thrive Apprentice and open the course you want to schedule

steps.raw_text: Click the **Content** tab to view all modules and lessons.
steps.context: tab to view all modules and lessons

steps.raw_text: Hover over the **Publish** icon next to the lesson or module you want to schedule.
steps.context: icon next to the lesson or module you want to schedule

steps.raw_text: Select **Schedule** from the options that appear.
Set the **date** and **time** you want the content to go live.
steps.context: and time you want the content to go live

steps.raw_text: Click **Save** to confirm the schedule.

sections.heading: Hiding Premium Courses from the Course List

steps.raw_text: Go to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice** > **Courses**.
Locate the premium course you want to hide.
Change the course status to **Hidden**.
Share the direct course URL only with authorized members or use your product access settings to control visibility.
Navigate to **Thrive Dashboard** > **Thrive Apprentice**.
Open the course you want to manage and click the **Content** tab.
Select the checkboxes next to the lessons, modules, or chapters you want to modify.
A **Bulk Actions** toolbar appears at the top of the content list.
steps.context: toolbar appears at the top of the content list

steps.raw_text: Choose the action you want to apply from the toolbar options.
Confirm the action to apply it to all selected items.
